info.title: dydt Market Data API
info.summary: Read-only Solana market data: tokens, pools, candles, trades, rankings, signals.
info.description: Authenticate with an API key from dydt.ai/developers/keys, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Every response is an envelope: code is 0 on success, otherwise error names the failure and message explains it. List endpoints that page return pagination.next_cursor; pass it back as cursor. Rate limits are reported in RateLimit-* headers and monthly quota in X-Quota-* headers.

ath_market_cap_usd.description: Highest market cap seen, in USD.

launch_price_quote.description: First traded price in the quote asset.

price_change_pct_quote.description: Price change since launch in quote terms.

price_change_pct_usd.description: Price change since launch in USD terms.

trader_count.description: Distinct wallets that have traded the token (approximate).

lp_burned_pct.description: Share of LP tokens burned and still locked, 0 to 100.

dev_pct.description: Share of supply held by the creator, 0 to 100.

sniper_pct.description: Share of supply held by sniper wallets, 0 to 100.

bundle_pct.description: Share of supply held by bundled launch buyers, 0 to 100.

bundler_count.description: Wallets that bought in bundled launch transactions.

top10_pct.description: Share of supply held by the 10 largest holders, 0 to 100.

mint_revoked.description: Whether the mint authority is revoked.

freeze_revoked.description: Whether the freeze authority is revoked.

dex_paid.description: Whether a DEX Screener profile was paid for.

bonding_curve_gain_5m_pct.description: Bonding curve progress gained in the last 5 minutes.

t.description: Windows present, in order. Every other array has one entry per window.

pp.description: Price change in percent, as [quote, usd].

windowed.description: Windowed metrics in compact columnar form: t lists the windows and every other array holds one entry per window at the same index.

get.description: The SOL reference price used across the API.

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor to get the next page; null on the last page.

code.description: Stable status code: the HTTP status times ten plus a digit for specific cases, for example 4013 invalid API key or 4291 quota exceeded.
